name: family.polypad/polypad
title: Polypad
description: Launch tokens and funds on Robinhood Chain. 27 tools, 5 skills. You sign everything.

tools.name: polypad_what_can_i_do
tools.description: Start here. Explains what Polypad on Robinhood Chain can do from chat, example requests, live counts, how signing works, and the guardrails.

tools.name: polypad_intent
tools.description: Turns a plain-language request ("buy 0.01 ETH of POLYCAT", "launch a fund with POLYDASH") into the right tool call. Runs read-only requests directly. For actions that move funds it needs the wallet address in `from`; if details are missing it returns the questions to ask.

text.description: What the user said, as written.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key. Omit it when a walletToken is passed — the wallet is resolved from the token instead.

walletToken.description: A wallet token from /sign?connect=1: connect once, store the token, and pass it instead of from on every prepare call. The wallet is resolved from the token (signature-checked, 90-day expiry). When both are passed they must name the same wallet.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_list_tokens
tools.description: Trending, new, graduating, or high-volume token launches on Polypad, with search. Counts activity from on-chain trades. No price predictions.

sort.description: trending, new, graduating, volume, or graduated.

q.description: Search by name, symbol, or address.

agentLaunched.description: Only tokens prepared through the agent API.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 50. Default 12.

tools.name: polypad_get_token
tools.description: One token: price reading, bonding-curve progress, creator, fees, and links. Accepts a symbol, name, token address, or launch address. POLYDASH itself works too — it is not a launch, so it has no curve or launch contract.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

tools.name: polypad_token_protections
tools.description: A plain-language read of a token's on-chain protections: liquidity, fees, creator holdings, staking pool, vesting lock, bond. It says what is met, what is not, and what it cannot tell you. Not a promise about price.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

tools.name: polypad_quote_trade
tools.description: Quote a buy (ETH in) or sell (token amount in) for a launch token, on the bonding curve or in the Uniswap V4 pool after graduation. Returns expected output, minimum after slippage, and fees. A reading, not a promise.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

amount.description: Base units as a decimal string: wei of ETH for a buy, token base units (18 decimals) for a sell.

amountEth.description: Buy only: ETH as a decimal such as 0.01. Use instead of amount.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

tools.name: polypad_quote_swap
tools.description: Compares one swap across KyberSwap, Velora, Bitget Wallet, and Uniswap on Robinhood Chain and returns the best route, with each venue's expected output. Quote only — it never signs or moves anything; polypad_prepare_swap turns the best route into an unsigned transaction inside the agent wallet limits. A venue that cannot quote reports why instead of failing the call.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: a token address on Robinhood Chain, or a symbol (ETH, WETH, USDG, POLYDASH).

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: a token address on Robinhood Chain, or a symbol (ETH, WETH, USDG, POLYDASH).

amountIn.description: Amount to sell, in the token's smallest units as a decimal string (e.g. 1000000000000000000 = 1 WETH).

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

tools.name: polypad_prepare_buy
tools.description: Prepares a buy of a launch token with ETH. Simulates it on-chain before returning. Returns the unsigned transaction (to, data, value, chainId 4663, gas estimate), a plain summary, and a one-tap signing link. Show the summary before the link. Never signs.

tools.name: polypad_prepare_swap
tools.description: Prepares a swap of any token for any token on Robinhood Chain through the best route across Velora, KyberSwap, Bitget Wallet, and Uniswap — or the venue you name. Re-quotes fresh, builds the unsigned transaction from that venue, adds the exact-amount approval step if needed, and simulates step 1 on-chain. Returns unsigned transactions, a summary, and a signing link. Never signs.

tools.name: polypad_prepare_nft_create
tools.description: Creates a fixed-price NFT collection on the Polypad NFT factory: name, symbol, artwork, max supply, mint price, and creator royalty. The caller signs once in their own wallet and pays gas only — creating a collection costs no ETH beyond gas. Only allowlisted business API keys can call it (used by Major League Operator Card Studio). Returns unsigned transactions, a summary, and a signing link.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key. Omit it when a walletToken is passed — the wallet is resolved from the token instead.

imageUri.description: Artwork URL (https:// or ipfs://). Shown as the collection image.

baseURI.description: Metadata base URI (https:// or ipfs://). Optional.

maxSupply.description: How many editions to mint, 1 to 10000. Default 25.

mintPriceEth.description: Mint price per edition in ETH as a plain decimal, above 0 to 10. Default 0.001. The factory does not allow a zero mint price. Use mintPriceWei instead for raw wei.

mintPriceWei.description: Mint price per edition in wei. Use instead of mintPriceEth.

royaltyBps.description: Creator royalty in basis points, 0 to 1500 (10% = 1000). Default 1000. Paid to the creator on every resale.

maxPerWallet.description: Max mints per wallet, 1 to 100. Default 5.

commitWindow.description: Commitment window in seconds, 1 hour to 30 days. Default 86400 (24 hours). Buyers commit first, then mint.

floorBps.description: Share of mint price kept in the collection floor vault, in basis points, 2000 to 8000. Default 2000 (20%).

tools.name: x402_cross_chain_quote
tools.description: Dry-run plan for paying any x402 endpoint from the other chain: fetch the 402, read the wallet's balances on Base and Robinhood Chain, and quote the Relay bridge for only the shortfall. Read-only — no key, no signature, nothing moves. Works for the USD stablecoins (USDG on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Base); a POLYDASH-only endpoint cannot cross-chain.

url.description: The x402 URL to pay — it must return a 402 payment challenge.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key. Omit it when a walletToken is passed — the wallet is resolved from the token instead.

tools.name: x402_cross_chain_pay
tools.description: The executable package for paying any x402 endpoint from the other chain: the dry-run plan, the unsigned Relay bridge transactions (approve + deposit, shortfall only), and the EIP-3009 typed data to sign for the settlement. Returns unsigned transactions only — the agent signs the bridge steps on the origin chain, waits for the bridge to land, signs the typed data, and POSTs it to the product URL as an X-PAYMENT header. Never signs, never takes a private key.

url.description: The x402 URL to pay — it must return a 402 payment challenge.

tools.name: polypad_agent_chat
tools.description: Run a business agent chat completion through Polypad: send a system prompt and messages, get the assistant reply. Only allowlisted business API keys can call it — every call is metered as API usage. The model is fixed (gpt-4o-mini) and the caller never sees the OpenAI key. Prompt and reply content is never logged.

systemPrompt.description: The system prompt for the business agent, 1 to 12000 characters.

messages.description: Chat messages, oldest first. 1 to 20 messages; each content 1 to 12000 characters.
